cures.text: Specimens were stored in a curing room at 25 °C and 100% relative humidity for around 3 h and then heated at 60 °C and ambient humidity and pressure for 2 h. After this heat treatment, they were put back in the curing room until around 24 h after mixing, when they were demolded. The demolded specimens were kept in the curing room until testing.
